races.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: SILK BRAID looked promising when scoring on debut and then was an improved second in listed company at Navan in April, shaping as if longer trips would suit so she's taken to make a winning start for a new yard on return from 7 months off. Nascondino has produced solid form of late and has a top rider aboard so he should capitalise if the returning selection doesn't give her running. SILK BRAID (IRE) NASCONDINO (IRE) ZERIYA

races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
races.verdict: BOY BASILICA won impressively over 9f at Wolverhampton 23 days ago and is open to plenty more progress making nursery debut. He can prove too good for hat-trick seeking Rogue Imperial , who produced his best display when upped to this trip at Epsom in September. Arthur Carrot has a bigger performance in him if settling better so could be one for the places, too. BOY BASILICA (FR) ROGUE IMPERIAL ARTHUR CARROT

races.title: AWC Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict: Preference is for ZOOELLA , who resumed her progress with a decisive victory at Southwell last month. She is fancied to record a fourth win of the year with more still to offer, though Startling isn't taken lightly after readily making all at Chelmsford on her latest outing, while Rajiba could go well back down in trip. ZOOELLA (IRE) STARTLING RAJIBA

races.title: All-Weather Championships Season XIV Fleur De Lys Fillies' Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict: Last year's heroine SKY SAFARI enhanced her fine record on speed-favouring all-weather tracks when landing the Winter Derby here back in February. Lightly raced and better than form figures would suggest thereafter, this has likely been her target again and James Fanshawe's mare rates a big player again. Kon Tiki (2-2 on all-weather) will find this more suitable than her Group 1 assignment latest and is feared, with improving 3-y-o Enchanted Queen also making the shortlist up in class. SKY SAFARI KON TIKI ENCHANTED QUEEN

races.title: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap
races.verdict: The likelihood of a strong pace to aim at ought to play firmly to the strengths of CREDIT FORGEDD IT who arrives on the back of solid placed efforts and starts out for a new yard who boast a very good record with similar types. Cooramook despite a potentially tricky draw, Snaafy and The Caribbean from his reduced mark are others to consider. CREDIT FORGEDD IT (IRE) COORAMOOK (IRE) SNAAFY

races.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict: GOT THE BOOTY has quickly found her feet for Clive Cox so she's fancied to go one better than on her last couple of starts with first-time cheekpieces applied. Nogo's Dream went close at Wolverhampton on penultimate start and having shaped as if still in good form in the mud at Bath since, he's put forward as the main threat. Magna may prove best of the rest. GOT THE BOOTY (FR) NOGO'S DREAM MAGNA
